messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — i uploaded a 'handoff ribbon' diagram for Q3 initiative sequencing. it's intentionally lightweight but shows the chains that can block launch: model quant -> dedicated capacity -> console telemetry -> customer rollout. link: https://internal.redwood/handoff-ribbon :eyes:
Devon Patel: saw it, thanks. can you call out the latency SLO dependency? runtime changes + kernel selection are on our critical path if we push 8k context persistency.
Maria Chen: added a small column for SLO risk. quick paste:
```
milestone,owner,due,slo-risk
model-quant,eng-ml,2026-06-15,high
dedicated-reserve,eng-infra,2026-06-22,medium
console-telemetry,product,2026-06-25,low
onprem-packaging,eng-platform,2026-07-01,medium
customer-rollout,cs,2026-07-10,depends
```
Sophie Li: design note — console change for per-route rollout toggles needs API flag. i can prototype a UX by next Tue but need an API shape from eng.
Kevin O'Neill: eng-infra constraints: GPU reservation window opens 6/20. if eng-ml needs earlier performance experiments we should request a short burst quota now. also: tagging required for Dedicated pools.
Priya Rao: can we make the launch criteria explicit here? propose: 1) 95th p90 latency < 450ms on our standard demo prompt, 2) fallback model validated, 3) console toggle + telemetry in place, 4) enterprise privacy checklist signed. thumbs if you agree. :+1:
Devon Patel: agree with criteria. note: fallback model validation will need a small eval set from CS — @Priya can you coordinate?
Priya Rao: will loop in CS. I'll add an item to the dependency map and assign owners.
deploy-bot: scheduled: "handoff-ribbon diagram reviewed" added to #product agenda for 2026-05-22 14:00 UTC.
Maria Chen: next actions i will: (a) freeze listed milestones by EOD Tue, (b) tag owners on the map, (c) open a short 'risk playbook' doc for the high SLO-risk items. if anyone needs scope trimmed to meet the 6/30 soft-freeze, call it out now.
Kevin O'Neill: request: eng-ml, please share perf test harness and config. we can reserve burst capacity if you give rough t-shirt estimate (small/medium/large).
Sophie Li: design will scope the API flag as small/medium depending on edge cases. i'll post the prototype and a minimal API sketch in the thread tomorrow.
Maria Chen: perfect. i'll update the ribbon with the t-shirt estimates once i see them. thanks all — keeping this tight will help avoid last-minute scope changes. :rocket:
